text:
Sonata



        Eyes that discover

        the voice of things.



        Ears that hear

        the passing of roses.



        Smell that fuses everything

        into a single aroma.



        Tongue that longs for

        the taste of another.



        Body the absence

        suffered by the four



        senses that carry it.

        Body that barely enjoys.



        It lacks touch.

        It has too much memory.

translation.title: Sonata
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog title differs, but the body is 'Sonata'; this version preserves the visible heading.
